note: What a client watching a match streamed over its connection (see spec/spectating.md) sends each time the server answers its registration, asking for the stream from a point. The header carries zero.

fields.name: jumpToLatest
fields.note: One where the client has no key frame yet and nothing past the end of the startup chunks: a client that can be joined late (see spec/spectating.md).

fields.name: fromChunk
fields.note: The first chunk wanted: one past the highest the client holds, 1 at first.

fields.name: fromKeyFrame
fields.note: The first key frame wanted: one past the latest the client holds, 1 at first.
